text: In 1932, twin brothers Smoke and Stack, World War I veterans home from the Chicago mob, [return to Clarksdale, Mississippi|trigger|going back home] and open a juke joint in an old sawmill. Their young cousin Sammie plays the blues so well that [his music summons spirits of past and future|images|ghosts and strange figures], drawing the Irish vampire Remmick and his thralls, who [offer money and music in exchange for entry|rules|it must be let in]. Inside, Smoke's estranged wife Annie puts her trust in [her Hoodoo practices|images|holy and occult objects] and pickled garlic.
